'''Steve Florent''' (forum handle '''hawkeyespf''') was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 51) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at Coralville/Iowa City, IA on the 4 June 2004 roster.<ref name="vol20040604">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040604020531/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 4 June 2004)</ref>

He held a tournament at Mayhem Comics in Ames, Iowa, in March 2003 and split a box of white-border Dagobah boosters among the players; in September 2003 he still had five or six boxes of it to give out as prizes until the Players Committee's new prize support system was in place.<ref name="pcf-2228-33753">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33753#33753 Anybody interested in Iowa tournaments??], Steve Florent, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 September 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014127/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39671%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In November 2003 he became a Product Champion for ''.hack//Enemy''.<ref name="pcf-2228-35134">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=35134#35134 Anybody interested in Iowa tournaments??], Steve Florent, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014127/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39671%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> From January 2004 he posted tournaments every other Saturday at MidAmerica Hobbies in North Liberty, Iowa.<ref name="pcf-2228-39671">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39671#39671 Anybody interested in Iowa tournaments??], Steve Florent, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014127/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39671%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
